svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "A dihybrid cross: two genes at once. Seed shape (R/r) and seed colour (Y/y) in peas."], [1, "Each parent makes four kinds of gamete in equal numbers: independent assortment."], [3.5, "The Punnett square shows all 16 combinations."], [10, "Phenotypes: 9 round yellow : 3 round green : 3 wrinkled yellow : 1 wrinkled green."]]
svg.title: Dihybrid cross
svg.desc: A dihybrid cross RrYy x RrYy for pea seed shape and colour: four gamete types from each parent, a 16-box Punnett square with drawn seeds, and the 9:3:3:1 ratio.
svg.text: R round, r wrinkled; Y yellow, y green. R and Y are dominant.

g.data-info: Both heterozygous for seed shape (R round, r wrinkled) and seed colour (Y yellow, y green). Round and yellow are dominant.
Independent assortment in meiosis: each gamete gets one allele of each gene, in four equally likely combinations: RY, Ry, rY, ry.
Every combination of the four gametes from each parent.
Round yellow 9, round green 3, wrinkled yellow 3, wrinkled green 1. This ratio shows the two genes assort independently (they are on different chromosomes).
